title: AAPS 4.0.0.0-dev-a problems with NSClientV3 Queue
symptom: The NSClientV3 Queue is high (e.g., 48) and doesn't come down, but after restarting AAPS and the Medtronic MMT754 pump connects, the queue drops. This repeats frequently.
cause: The queue backlog is a temporary state until history is read from the pump, which is Medtronic-specific because loading pump history takes time.
fix: No fix needed; it is temporary. Restarting AAPS helps but is not required.
evidence_quote: this is only temporary state until history is read from pump. medtronic specific no need to fix it
